node.statement: Replace projections by compressed units. By node 1.2 and the multiplication bound in epsilon-banach-cstar-norm-axioms, ||(u_{T,n}-T_n)A||<=2*K_u*e||A|| and ||A(u_{R,n}-R_n)||<=2*K_u*e||A||. Combining these with nodes 1.3.1 and 1.3.2 proves node 1.3 with K_a=max(K_T,K_R)+2*K_u.
